fields.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
fields.description: An open-world RPG where you play as Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter searching for his adopted daughter.

fields.title: Cyberpunk 2077
fields.description: An open-world action RPG set in Night City, where you play as a mercenary named V.

fields.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
fields.description: An open-world action-adventure game following Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang.

fields.title: Minecraft
fields.description: A sandbox game where players can explore, build structures, collect resources, and survive in a block-based world.

fields.title: Elden Ring
fields.description: An action RPG featuring a large open world, challenging combat, exploration, and powerful enemies.

fields.title: Hades
fields.description: A fast-paced roguelike action game where Zagreus attempts to escape the Underworld.

fields.title: Hollow Knight
fields.description: A challenging 2D action-adventure game set in a mysterious underground kingdom.

fields.title: Stardew Valley
fields.description: A farming and life simulation game where you build a farm, meet villagers, explore caves, and develop relationships.

fields.title: Baldur's Gate 3
fields.description: A story-driven RPG with turn-based combat, character customization, exploration, and branching choices.

fields.title: Portal 2
fields.description: A puzzle game where players solve physics-based challenges using a portal gun.
